# RoboBattle — RoboScript

> A small line-based language for programming battle robots, run entirely in
> the browser. These files describe it completely and are generated from the
> game's own grammar, so they cannot fall behind it.

- [Everything in one file](https://mattoates.github.io/robotbattle/skill/roboscript.md)
- [Skill card](https://mattoates.github.io/robotbattle/skill/SKILL.md)
- [Reference](https://mattoates.github.io/robotbattle/skill/reference.md)
- [Worked examples](https://mattoates.github.io/robotbattle/skill/examples.md)
- [Play it](https://mattoates.github.io/robotbattle/play/)
